class_kind.description: How the class is parameterised at the substrate-DoF level.

perfect_math_substrate_dof_cost.description: Per [[project_a_n_operators_are_harmonic_objects_themselves]] §B: which substrate-DoF the class's cost-to-solve lives in (1D algebraic / 3D spatial / 7D_g gauge / 11D substrate-traversal). Defensive-scope-only.

open_separator_status.description: Is the inclusion-vs-equality with the containing class open? Documented barriers (relativisation, natural-proofs, algebrisation) noted here.

cascade_decomposition_signature.description: Hurwitz-partition signature of classes_used per the 1+3+7+3 candidate partition.

framework_anchor.description: Link to MFO §, srmech §, Spike #, or project memory anchor.
